params._comment: Day-14 finale descent, CUT-END restage: player-anchored reverse-intro drop that hands the camera back at the watcher's own eyes, slowed to 280t. The opening keyframe lookAt-tracks the eclipse:altar_center FX anchor (synced by IntroSequence; a missing anchor degrades to the keyed yaw/pitch) so the shot opens ON the glowing altar under a warm dawn-cream fade (FFF6E7C8, 44t bloom-out) and a sanctum-hum swell, then the 90°/s-clamped aim hands off to the player over the first segment. Every later keyframe lookAt-tracks the player, so showOwnBody stays true — the shot is ABOUT the returning player.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
